mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_info (model_name, model_type, algorithm, accuracy, description, cover, model_api, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{modelName}, #{modelType}, #{algorithm}, #{accuracy}, #{description}, #{cover}, #{modelApi}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE model_info SET model_name = #{modelName}, model_type = #{modelType}, algorithm = #{algorithm}, accuracy = #{accuracy}, description = #{description}, cover = #{cover}, model_api = #{modelApi}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, model_name, model_type, algorithm, accuracy, description, cover, model_api, status, create_time, update_time FROM model_info WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, model_name, model_type, algorithm, accuracy, description, cover, model_api, status, create_time, update_time FROM model_info WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT id, model_name, model_type, algorithm, accuracy, description, cover, model_api, status, create_time, update_time FROM model_info WHERE status != #{status} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, model_name, model_type, algorithm, accuracy, description, cover, model_api, status, create_time, update_time FROM model_info ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, model_name, model_type, algorithm, accuracy, description, cover, model_api, status, create_time, update_time FROM model_info ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_info WHERE status = #{status}
